about: The capture golden corpus. secrets[0] is the primary secret a parser must lock into the protected slot; further entries are secondary secrets that must be captured as secrets and never stored as an ordinary field. template 'custom' means no specific template. Built by testsets/build_capture_golden.py — edit that script, not this file.

metrics.found: the parser returns at least one secret
metrics.primary: the parser's primary secret equals secrets[0] (for URI-embedded passwords: the percent-decoded one)
metrics.template: the detected template equals `template` ('custom' means none)
metrics.secondary: for cases with more than one secret: every secondary secret is captured as a secret
metrics.leaks: known secrets (any encoded form) appearing in an ordinary, non-hidden field or in a stored excerpt — must be 0
metrics.negatives: cases with secrets == [] must not produce a secret in the app capture engine
metrics.false_positives: a negative case that produced a secret; must be 0 in the app capture engine

floors.note: Hand-maintained counts. found/primary/template are measured over positive cases (303); negatives are the 38 cases with secrets == []. Raise a floor when a parser improves; never lower one to make a regression pass.
